decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered out the carrying cases, power adapters, and novelty items to focus on performance-oriented speakers. My consideration set includes a mix of mid-range (Bogasing, Tenmiya), premium (JBL, Harman Kardon), and luxury (Bang & Olufsen) options. I selected the Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 as the final choice because it maintains an exceptionally high rating (4.7) from over 2,000 reviews, indicating consistent quality and powerful bass performance. While the Bang & Olufsen model is a strong competitor, the Harman Kardon offers better value for professional-grade audio at nearly half the price.
